import primitive_api as api

target = 'SoapBar|-02.20|+00.81|+00.34'   # pink bar on the CounterTop next to the sink

print('POSE:', obs.get('agent'))
print('INV0:', [o.get('objectId') for o in api.query_inventory()])

ap = api.approach_object(target, max_steps=4, stop_distance=1.0)
print('APPROACH:', ap.get('final_distance'), ap.get('events'))

import primitive_api as api

target = 'SoapBar|-02.20|+00.81|+00.34'
def vis_ids(q):
    return [o['objectId'] for o in api.detect_objects(query=q)]
def agent():
    return api.observe().get('agent')
print('POSE:', agent())

# 1) Reacquire the counter soap: try tilting down and rotating, bounded.
found = target in vis_ids('SoapBar')
tries = [('look','down'),('rotate','left'),('rotate','left'),('look','up'),('rotate','right')]
for kind, d in tries:
    if found: break
    r = api.look(d) if kind == 'look' else api.rotate(d)
    found = target in vis_ids('SoapBar')
    print(kind, d, 'found=', found, 'soaps=', vis_ids('SoapBar'))
if not found:
    ap = api.approach_object(target, max_steps=3, stop_distance=0.7)
    print('APPROACH3:', ap.get('final_distance'), 'POSE', agent())
    for d in ['down', 'down']:
        found = target in vis_ids('SoapBar')
        if found: break
        api.look(d)
    found = target in vis_ids('SoapBar')
print('FOUND target:', found, 'POSE', agent())

if found:
    pk = api.pickup_object(target)
    print('PICKUP:', pk)
inv = [o.get('objectId') for o in api.query_inventory()]
print('INV:', inv)

# 2) Wash in sink basin
if target in inv:
    basins = vis_ids('SinkBasin')
    print('BASINS vis:', basins)
    if not basins:
        api.approach_object('Sink|-02.54|+00.66|+00.25|SinkBasin', max_steps=3, stop_distance=0.9)
        basins = vis_ids('SinkBasin')
        print('BASINS vis2:', basins)
    if basins:
        b = 'Sink|-02.54|+00.66|+00.25|SinkBasin' if 'Sink|-02.54|+00.66|+00.25|SinkBasin' in basins else basins[0]
        print('PUT sink:', api.put_object(target, b))
        fau = vis_ids('Faucet')
        print('FAUCETS:', fau)
        if fau:
            print('ON:', api.toggle_object(fau[0], on=True))
            print('OFF:', api.toggle_object(fau[0], on=False))
        print('SOAP state:', api.query_object_state(target))
        print('PICK back:', api.pickup_object(target))
print('INV2:', [o.get('objectId') for o in api.query_inventory()])
print('PROG:', api.check_progress_public())
api.write_evidence('turn5', {'found': found, 'inv': [o.get('objectId') for o in api.query_inventory()]})

print('INV2:', [o.get('objectId') for o in api.query_inventory()])
print('SUCCESS:', api.check_success())

import primitive_api as api
T = 'SoapBar|-02.20|+00.81|+00.34'
B = 'Sink|-02.54|+00.66|+00.25|SinkBasin'
F = 'Faucet|-02.54|+00.79|+00.11'
TB = 'Bathtub|-03.59|+00.11|+01.52|BathtubBasin'
def ids(q): return [o['objectId'] for o in api.detect_objects(query=q)]
def short(r): return {k: r.get(k) for k in ('valid_action','error','ok')} if isinstance(r, dict) else r
def held(): return T in [o.get('objectId') for o in api.query_inventory()]
print('START:', api.check_progress_public()['goal_conditions_met'], api.observe().get('agent'))
# 1) retrieve soap from tub
if not held():
    if T in ids('SoapBar'):
        print('PICK tub:', short(api.pickup_object(T)))
    if not held():
        api.approach_object(T, max_steps=3, stop_distance=0.9)
        if T in ids('SoapBar'):
            print('PICK tub2:', short(api.pickup_object(T)))
print('HELD:', held())
# 2) wash: ensure soap really sits in sink basin, then faucet on
if held():
    if B not in ids('SinkBasin'):
        api.approach_object(B, max_steps=4, stop_distance=0.8)
    print('BASIN vis:', B in ids('SinkBasin'), 'FAUCET vis:', F in ids('Faucet'))
    print('PUT sink:', short(api.put_object(T, B)))
    st = api.query_object_state(T)
    print('SOAP parents:', st.get('parentReceptacles') if isinstance(st, dict) else st)
    if not held():
        if F not in ids('Faucet'):
            api.look('down')
        print('ON:', short(api.toggle_object(F, on=True)))
        print('PROG on:', api.check_progress_public()['goal_conditions_met'])
        st = api.query_object_state(T)
        print('SOAP state:', st)
        print('OFF:', short(api.toggle_object(F, on=False)))
        print('PICK:', short(api.pickup_object(T)))
    print('PROG washed:', api.check_progress_public()['goal_conditions_met'])
# 3) put back in tub
if held():
    if TB in ids('BathtubBasin'):
        r = api.put_object(T, TB); print('PUT tub direct:', short(r))
    if held():
        pl = api.place_held_object('BathtubBasin', obj=T, aliases=['BathtubBasin','Bathtub'], support_queries=['Bathtub'], search_budget=16)
        print('PLACE ok:', pl.get('ok'))
print('INV:', [o.get('objectId') for o in api.query_inventory()])
print('SUCCESS:', api.check_success())
print('STEPS:', api.check_progress_public().get('env_steps'))
